definitions.full: H780. Ararat אֲרָרַט proper name, of a territory Ararat (Assyrian Urar‰u COT Gloss , compare Lag Armen. Stud. § 100 ) — ׳א Jer 51:27 ; אֲרָרָ֑ט Gen 8:4 3 t. — a district in Eastern Armenia between the river Araxes & lakes Van & Oroomiah, compare KGF; to this probably reference in 2Kin 19:37 = Isa 37:38 א ׳אֶרֶץ ; also Gen 8:4 א ׳הָרֵי , where the ark rested; used perhaps with wider reference Jer 51:27 א ׳מַמְלְכוֺת (|| אַשְׁכְּנַז מִנִּי, ).
